name: Vishal Paliwal
summary: Personal site of an iOS and web product engineer: SwiftUI animation examples, AI-agent skills for micro-interactions, and a blog.
description: Portfolio and product site of Vishal Paliwal, a product engineer shipping iOS and web apps, SaaS and AI features (13 years). Its free skill for AI coding agents generates complete SwiftUI micro-interactions (spring physics, CoreHaptics, glass morphism) from plain English prompts, built from 84 hand-crafted animation demos; a Pro superset and an App Store ship kit are also offered, alongside an animations gallery, a playground, an audit page and a blog. Section pages render client-side, so only titles, sitemap and linked repo were readable.
contains: free micro-interaction skill for AI coding agents (117 GitHub stars, 5 forks)
skill writes complete compilable .swift files from plain English, in create and edit modes
covers spring physics, CoreHaptics and glass morphism
built from 'legendary-Animo': 84 hand-crafted SwiftUI animation demos
Pro version is a licensed, private superset with exclusive patterns
installs via skills.sh CLI, Claude Code plugin, manual install or any AI agent
site sitemap lists 168 URLs incl. animations, playground, skills, audit and blog sections
